text:
[Council File 26-1428; CD 2]
Motion (Nazarian – Padilla) relative to reconfiguring the NoHo DASH line as NoHo2BUR Connect, a direct transit connection between North Hollywood Station and Hollywood Burbank Airport.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to reconfigure the NoHo DASH line as a direct NoHo2BUR Connect service between North Hollywood Station and Hollywood Burbank Airport.
